observations: Not caused by this change: a frozen process (SIGSTOP) that holds a document's lock, pg_advisory_lock(hashtext(room)), keeps the other process from storing that document's keystrokes until it resumes. pg_locks shows B's backend idle and holding the lock while A's backend waits. A stores the keystroke about 23 ms after SIGCONT. Frequency: 3 of 16 runs at ff5c1919, 1 of 8 at 9788cded, 1 of 2 at 9952be5a, 8 of 8 at aa50b68c (behaviour before this change). Locking the document has this effect whenever a holder freezes, and this change makes it rarer.
When a room on another process expires an awareness client from a killed process, tabs that are already open get no removal message. y-protocols browsers time the client out themselves after 30 s.
